Subject: Temporary job-share + mentorship handback proposal for Monica's phased return

Hi all,

Following Monica's update last week about her upcoming leave and the need for a gradual ramp-back, I put together a lightweight proposal for a temporary job-share + mentorship handback to cover critical deliverables while preserving continuity. Drafts are attached: a job-share agreement and a handback checklist.

High-level proposal (summary):
- Duration: 12 weeks total (6 weeks active job-share, 6 weeks phased handback/mentorship)
- Schedule: Monica at 60% FTE (remote-first) for first 6 weeks after leave, transitioning to 80% for the next 6 weeks with scheduled overlap days with the backup partner.
- Coverage: Nina Gomez (temp contractor via agency) to take primary backlog triage & on-call rotation initially; Markus and Tessa to act as mentors/knowledge-transfer docs and point owners.
- Handover: Use the attached checklist; weekly syncs (30m) during overlap; written runbook updates owned by Markus.

As Monica's manager I want to make sure we balance operational needs and accommodation flexibility. Monica — could you confirm whether remote-first + 60% for the initial period works medically/operationally? Laura/Vivek — is the job-share template acceptable from an HR/benefits standpoint? Also tagging Markus & Tessa for feasibility on handoff tasks.

Next steps: if there are no major blockers, can we:
1) HR review & sign the job-share agreement (Laura)
2) Ben to confirm assignment of Nina via procurement and get SOW in place
3) Monica to sign off on schedule and provide any required physician note (I flagged a slot on calendar for a quick sync Wednesday 11am PT)

Thanks — Ben

--

Ben — thanks for drafting this and for the thoughtful approach. I appreciate the flexibility. A few notes from my side:

- Medical: my OB recommended a 6-week remote-first period after delivery with a gradual return to on-site duties. I'll forward a physician note to HR tomorrow (attaching a stub here for tracking).
- Capacity: 60% for the first 6 weeks sounds right. I would prefer my overlap days with the temp to be Tuesdays and Thursdays for the first month so I can keep consistent pediatric appointments.
- Mentorship: I like the idea of pairing with Markus for backlog triage and with Tessa for the on-call runbook updates. Could we limit my initial documentation tasks to top-5 priority playbooks so I can focus on onboarding the temp?

I also want to request that we explicitly remove me from any new hiring interview loops during the first 8 weeks post-return, if possible.

Thanks — M
